# Notices

## RPEIF

The original R package is authored by Anthony Christidis, Shengyu Zhang, and
Douglas Martin and is licensed under GPL (>= 2). An unmodified source snapshot
is included under `upstream/RPEIF-master`.

## RobStatTM-derived numerical code

The files under `vendor/robstattm-lite` are derived from the completed modern
Fortran translation of RobStatTM and retain GPL-3.0-or-later SPDX headers. Only
the kind definitions and psi-function subsystem needed by RPEIF are included.

## Combined license

Because GPL-3.0-or-later code is combined with GPL-2.0-or-later RPEIF code, the
combined library is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Complete GPL-2.0-or-
later and GPL-3.0-or-later texts are included in `LICENSES`.
